name: AAPL Dividend Anomaly Analysis
description: Research study analyzing the relationship between AAPL's dividend yield and stock price movements over the last 2 years
source:
# AAPL Dividend Anomaly Analysis
# Examining the relationship between dividend yield and price movements (Feb 2024 - Jan 2026)

# =============================================================================
# DATA SOURCES
# =============================================================================

# Price data
src = market_data_source(timeframe=1D)()
close = src.c
high = src.h
low = src.l
open_price = src.o
volume = src.v

# Dividend data - Cash Dividends (CD)
div = dividends(dividend_type=DividendType.CD)()
cash_amount = div.cash_amount
split_adj_amount = div.split_adjusted_cash_amount
pay_date = div.pay_date
record_date = div.record_date
declaration_date = div.declaration_date
frequency = div.frequency

# =============================================================================
# DIVIDEND ANALYSIS
# =============================================================================

# Identify dividend payment dates (when cash_amount is not null)
had_dividend = is_valid(cash_amount)

# Fill forward last dividend amount and frequency
last_div_amount = ffill(cash_amount)
last_freq = ffill(frequency)

# Calculate dividend yield (annualized)
# Yield = (last dividend amount * frequency) / current price
div_yield = (last_div_amount * last_freq) / close

# Bars since last dividend
bars_since_div = barssince()(had_dividend)

# Days since dividend (approximate)
days_since_div = bars_since_div

# =============================================================================
# RETURNS ANALYSIS
# =============================================================================

# Historical returns
ret_1d = roc(period=1)(close)
ret_1w = roc(period=5)(close)
ret_2w = roc(period=10)(close)
ret_1m = roc(period=21)(close)
ret_3m = roc(period=63)(close)

# Forward returns (look-ahead for analysis)
fwd_ret_1w = forward_returns(period=5, return_type=ReturnType.simple)(close)
fwd_ret_1m = forward_returns(period=21, return_type=ReturnType.simple)(close)
fwd_ret_3m = forward_returns(period=63, return_type=ReturnType.simple)(close)

# =============================================================================
# DIVIDEND DATE ANALYSIS
# =============================================================================

# Returns around dividend dates
# Get returns 5 days before and after dividend
ret_5d_before = roc(period=5)(close)
ret_5d_after = fwd_ret_1w

# Price change on dividend day
price_change_pct = ret_1d

# High/Low range on dividend day
hl_range = (high - low) / close

# =============================================================================
# MONTHLY DIVIDEND FLAG
# =============================================================================

# Extract month from index
current_month = datetime_extract(component='month')(index())
last_div_month = datetime_extract(component='month')(pay_date)
last_div_month_filled = ffill(last_div_month)

# Flag for dividend month (same month as last dividend or within 30 days)
is_div_month = bars_since_div <= 21

# Returns in dividend vs non-dividend months
ret_in_div_month = where(is_div_month, ret_1m)
ret_in_non_div_month = where(not is_div_month, ret_1m)

# =============================================================================
# REPORTERS - CATEGORY 1: OVERVIEW
# =============================================================================

# Summary cards
cards(
    layout=CardLayout(
        title="Dividend Overview",
        cells=[
            ColumnSpec(title="Avg Dividend Yield", card_agg=AggregationType.Mean, card_slot=CardSlot.Hero, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2, card_color=Color.Primary),
            ColumnSpec(title="Total Dividends Paid", card_agg=AggregationType.Sum, card_slot=CardSlot.Details, type=CardRenderType.MonetaryFormat, dp=2, card_color=Color.Success),
            ColumnSpec(title="Dividend Frequency", card_agg=AggregationType.Mean, card_slot=CardSlot.Details, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=0, card_color=Color.Info),
            ColumnSpec(title="Avg Days Between Divs", card_agg=AggregationType.Mean, card_slot=CardSlot.Details, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=0, card_color=Color.Secondary)
        ]
    ),
    category="1. Overview"
)(div_yield, cash_amount, frequency, days_since_div)

# Price and dividend timeline
timeseries_lines(
    title="AAPL Stock Price & Dividend Yield",
    category="1. Overview",
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name="Close Price ($)", color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name="Dividend Yield (%)", color=Color.Emerald, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash)
    ])
)(close, div_yield)

# =============================================================================
# REPORTERS - CATEGORY 2: DIVIDEND TIMING
# =============================================================================

# Days since dividend chart
timeseries_lines(
    title="Days Since Last Dividend Payment",
    category="2. Dividend Timing",
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name="Days Since Dividend", color=Color.Purple)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=91, title="~Quarterly (91d)", color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dot)
    ])
)(days_since_div)

# Dividend amount over time
timeseries_lines(
    title="Dividend Payment Amount",
    category="2. Dividend Timing",
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name="Cash Dividend ($)", color=Color.Gold)
    ])
)(last_div_amount)

# =============================================================================
# REPORTERS - CATEGORY 3: YIELD VS RETURNS
# =============================================================================

# Summary cards for returns
cards(
    layout=CardLayout(
        title="Returns Analysis",
        cells=[
            ColumnSpec(title="Avg 1M Return (Div Months)", card_agg=AggregationType.Mean, card_slot=CardSlot.Hero, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2, card_color=Color.Success),
            ColumnSpec(title="Avg 1M Return (Non-Div)", card_agg=AggregationType.Mean, card_slot=CardSlot.Details, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2, card_color=Color.Warning),
            ColumnSpec(title="Avg 1W Fwd Return", card_agg=AggregationType.Mean, card_slot=CardSlot.Details, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2, card_color=Color.Info)
        ]
    ),
    category="3. Yield vs Returns"
)(ret_in_div_month, ret_in_non_div_month, fwd_ret_1w)

# Scatter: Dividend Yield vs Forward Returns
xy_scatter(
    title="Dividend Yield vs 1-Month Forward Return",
    category="3. Yield vs Returns",
    x_axis_label="Dividend Yield (%)",
    y_axis_label="1-Month Forward Return (%)",
    x_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.PercentFormat,
    x_axis_dp=2,
    y_axis_dp=2,
    series=ScatterSeriesSchema(series=[
        ScatterSeriesSpec(name="Yield vs Return", color=Color.Blue, marker=MarkerSymbol.CircleMarker)
    ])
)(x=div_yield, y_values=fwd_ret_1m)

# Scatter: Dividend Yield vs 3M Forward Returns
xy_scatter(
    title="Dividend Yield vs 3-Month Forward Return",
    category="3. Yield vs Returns",
    x_axis_label="Dividend Yield (%)",
    y_axis_label="3-Month Forward Return (%)",
    x_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.PercentFormat,
    x_axis_dp=2,
    y_axis_dp=2,
    series=ScatterSeriesSchema(series=[
        ScatterSeriesSpec(name="Yield vs 3M Return", color=Color.Purple, marker=MarkerSymbol.DiamondMarker)
    ])
)(x=div_yield, y_values=fwd_ret_3m)

# Returns comparison timeline
timeseries_lines(
    title="Returns: Dividend Months vs Non-Dividend Months",
    category="3. Yield vs Returns",
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name="Dividend Month Returns", color=Color.Green),
        LineSeriesSpec(name="Non-Dividend Month Returns", color=Color.Red)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0, title="Zero", color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash)
    ])
)(ret_in_div_month, ret_in_non_div_month)

# =============================================================================
# REPORTERS - CATEGORY 4: PRICE ACTION AROUND DIVIDENDS
# =============================================================================

# Returns before/after dividends
timeseries_lines(
    title="Returns Around Dividend Dates",
    category="4. Price Action",
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name="5-Day Before", color=Color.Orange),
        LineSeriesSpec(name="5-Day After", color=Color.Cyan),
        LineSeriesSpec(name="1-Day Change", color=Color.Red, dash_style=DashStyle.Dot)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0, title="Zero", color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash)
    ])
)(ret_5d_before, ret_5d_after, price_change_pct)

# Volatility on dividend days
timeseries_lines(
    title="Intraday Range (High-Low/Close)",
    category="4. Price Action",
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name="H-L Range %", color=Color.Violet)
    ])
)(hl_range)

# =============================================================================
# REPORTERS - CATEGORY 5: DISTRIBUTIONS
# =============================================================================

# Forward returns distribution
histogram(
    title="Distribution of 1-Month Forward Returns",
    category="5. Distributions",
    bins=30,
    x_axis_label="1-Month Forward Return (%)",
    x_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.PercentFormat,
    x_axis_dp=1,
    fill_color=Color.Blue,
    fill_opacity=0.7
)(fwd_ret_1m)

# Dividend yield distribution
histogram(
    title="Distribution of Dividend Yields",
    category="5. Distributions",
    bins=25,
    x_axis_label="Dividend Yield (%)",
    x_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.PercentFormat,
    x_axis_dp=2,
    fill_color=Color.Emerald,
    fill_opacity=0.7
)(div_yield)

# =============================================================================
# EVENT MARKERS - DIVIDEND DATES
# =============================================================================

event_marker(
    schema=EventMarkerSchema(
        title="Dividend Payment Dates",
        icon=Icon.DollarSignIcon,
        schemas=[
            ColumnSpec(title="Filter", table_is_filter=True, table_visible=False),
            ColumnSpec(title="Dividend ($)", type=CardRenderType.MonetaryFormat, dp=3, card_slot=CardSlot.Hero, card_color=Color.Success),
            ColumnSpec(title="Yield (%)", type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2, card_slot=CardSlot.Details, card_color=Color.Primary),
            ColumnSpec(title="Price ($)", type=CardRenderType.MonetaryFormat, dp=2, card_slot=CardSlot.Details),
            ColumnSpec(title="5d Before Return", type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2, card_slot=CardSlot.Details),
            ColumnSpec(title="5d After Return", type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2, card_slot=CardSlot.Details),
            ColumnSpec(title="1d Change", type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2, card_slot=CardSlot.Footer)
        ]
    )
)(had_dividend, cash_amount, div_yield, close, ret_5d_before, ret_5d_after, price_change_pct)
